In the first round, a moderate contribution can signal willingness to cooperate while testing others' behavior.

Based on my prior play style (cautious in Trust Game with [10], fair in Ultimatum with [40] to Responder), I'll start with a cooperative but not maximal contribution to encourage group benefit without excessive risk.

My contribution for the first round is: [10]
